chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea at Sludge Spinner, then Water's Edge at Sludge Spinner, then Coral Guard. This used all 3 energy, dealt 15 damage, and gained 5 Block before the enemy's telegraphed 8 damage attack.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Rally the Isles first to gain 1 Charge and possibly create random Inazuma Companion cards, then playing All Streams Flow to the Sea if it survived Muster. I rejected it because Muster 2 transforms two cards in hand at random, could remove All Streams Flow to the Sea or Coral Guard, and the guaranteed line with both damage cards and block is safer.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up Rally the Isles' Charge gain and random Companion transformation, any possible extra damage from higher Charge, and any chance at useful random cards. It also commits all energy, leaving no saved energy.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. The declared intent is an 8 damage attack, and the chosen line already uses all affordable cards with no known downside. A different telegraphed intent would not make me drop the two damage cards or Coral Guard; if the attack were larger, the 5 Block would be even more useful, and if it were non-attack, the Block is still harmless.
